name: DuckOS freestanding kernel
purpose: Define the compiler and runtime gates required before Reaper can produce executable DuckOS kernel code.

reference_runtime.scope: hosted Python reference semantics; not available in a freestanding kernel

vm.scope: hosted bytecode VM; depends on a host runtime and is not kernel startup code

native_aot.backend: generated C17 compiled by host GCC/Clang-compatible toolchain

native_c_core.scope: C17 lexer, expression parser, owned AST, checked scalar IR and limited lowering; not complete Reaper source-language code generation

hardware_adapter.scope: checked MMIO descriptors and host-supplied bus callbacks; no physical mapping, privileged instruction, real IRQ or DMA runtime

embedded_workbench.scope: MCU profiles, linker-script generation and external C toolchain invocation; not an x86_64 DuckOS kernel target

duckos_reference_contract.scope: DuckOS policy modules and contract suite; host execution only

required_compiler_capabilities.acceptance: u8/u16/u32/u64, i8/i16/i32/i64, usize/isize with checked layout and overflow semantics
struct/enum layout, field offsets, align/packed and ABI layout assertions
typed pointers, references, slices, address spaces and explicit unsafe boundaries
no host libc/runtime, explicit entry point, panic handler, allocator hooks and deterministic startup
native IR and lowering for lists, indexing, iteration, imports and collection pipelines used by existing DuckOS contracts
static initialization, borrowing, aliasing, lifetime, drop/defer and resource-release checks
typed memory, io, mmio, irq, dma, process and unsafe effects checked before code generation
volatile width-aware register access, explicit ordering, atomic operations, fences and DMA synchronization
interrupt entry/exit, preserved register sets, naked/assembly boundary and context-switch calling convention
target object emission, relocations, linker scripts, sections, symbol visibility and undefined-symbol audit
source maps, DWARF or target debugger metadata, panic stack traces and symbolized emulator logs
pinned compiler/linker, deterministic artifacts, differential tests and versioned QEMU boot profile

promotion_rules: A target feature is available only when grammar, AST, type/effect rule, runtime, native lowering, negative tests and target evidence agree.
Reference-runtime or VM success is not native-code generation or privileged execution.
The target architecture and boot protocol must be approved before ABI layout or entry code is frozen.
No kernel migration milestone is complete without reproducible object/linker output and emulator evidence.
